automatedTests.mediaTools: ffmpeg/ffprobe 9.0.2 from the Windows build linked by ffmpeg.org
automatedTests.coverage: Actual patched KillBannerHud consumes kill events and draws the source-colored radial pips (or documented generic fallback), including two opposite pips, headshots and modulo-five repetition. No image construction, fetch or decoding is allowed during HUD drawing. Partial preload/failure/retry behavior is checked separately.

browserPixelReview.method: A temporary isolated localhost review page imports the delivered skin runtime and executes cR/cP/ol extracted from the delivered DVK7uRSu.js. All image layers are loaded from the installed local server. Each palette renders kills 1–5 to real browser canvases; PNG pixels are compared for five distinct images per palette.
browserPixelReview.regressionFoundAndFixed: Initial real-pixel review found repeated Ayakashi output despite correct draw-call counts. Its source pip PNGs are transparent 1x1 placeholders. Four explicit generic-chevron fallbacks now produce visible radial progression; skin-specific Ayakashi pip VFX remain unavailable.

installedApplicationSmoke.manualLiveKills: not exercised; actual kill dispatch/HUD behavior is covered by the automated tests and real-pixel review

limitations: Ayakashi retains its original frame/ring/emblem with generic white radial markers because its four source pip images are blank placeholders.
The client uses its existing native HUD animation. Original Unreal shader/VFX animation is not reproduced.
